scope: Supplemental public-data access evidence for a permanently free local skill using the user's own agent. Documentation only; no runtime allowlist decisions.

method.retention: Paraphrases and official URLs only; no full-page legal snapshots retained.
method.retrieval_note: Read official pages and official indexed excerpts. Login/JavaScript/error cases are marked. Search results from third parties were not used as evidence.

status_interpretation: Statuses describe evidence, not legal verdicts.
Unknown or permission_not_established is neither permission nor a finding of illegality.
A documented API licenses a delivery mechanism only to the extent its terms and underlying content rights permit.
A public webpage, an OGL footer on a publication, and a dataset-specific reuse licence are distinct.
Robots is a separate access protocol; no content licence is inferred from allowance or silence.
No-contact/no-account/no-payment constraints apply to this audit. Future pathways are not actions taken.

providers.name: Companies House — public register/API

evidence.paraphrase: Companies House-created material and public-register filings have different legal bases. The register is disclosed under statutory approvals; Companies House places no reuse restrictions of its own, but third-party copyright and other law remain relevant.
Official API allows 600 requests per five minutes; repeated excess or attempts to bypass limits may cause a ban.

providers.eligibility: Developer account/application and API key; only read endpoints are relevant here.
providers.no_paste_route: Use the official company-search/profile API, retaining company number, source and checked date. HTML scraping is unnecessary for supported fields.
providers.uncertainty: No live key or API call was tested. Publication rights over each filed document and personal information are not established by the API's availability.

providers.name: HM Land Registry — Price Paid Data

evidence.paraphrase: PPD is OGL v3 with required HMLR attribution. Address fields include OS/Royal Mail rights: the supplied permission covers personal/noncommercial use and residential-price-information display; other address uses require separate permission.
Official monthly/yearly/full CSV and linked-data routes are provided. Separate conditions apply to UPRN and INSPIRE lookup tables.

providers.eligibility: Public download; no account required for linked public files.
providers.no_paste_route: Download an appropriate official CSV once, query locally and apply monthly updates; use the documented report/linked-data route for small searches.
providers.uncertainty: Sale-price history is not current rental stock, a current valuation or proof of ownership. Do not extend PPD permission to title registers or unrelated address databases.

providers.name: HM Land Registry — title register/title plan

evidence.paraphrase: Online title-register and title-plan copies cost £7 each; official copies cost £11 each. Ordinary downloaded copies are not official proof of ownership.

providers.eligibility: Use the official purchasing flow if independently authorised; account/payment conditions were not exercised.
providers.no_paste_route: A user who already lawfully has a title PDF can select the local file for limited analysis; do not initiate a purchase in the free/no-payment workflow.
providers.uncertainty: Price Paid's OGL does not license title PDFs. Local PDF processing and onward disclosure still depend on document rights and personal-data context.

providers.name: Valuation Office Agency — Council Tax band lookup

evidence.paraphrase: VOA says its web application supports checking a property and nearby bands. It declined bulk-list disclosure, citing its statutory functions and taxpayer-confidentiality duties.

providers.no_paste_route: Provide the official band-lookup link; a single user-directed AI interaction needs service-access review. Do not quietly substitute a bulk collector or rateable-value business dataset.
providers.uncertainty: The disclosure decision concerns VOA's release of bulk data; it is not a ruling that every individual automated lookup is unlawful. Live service was not readable in this audit. GOV.UK publication OGL is not a bulk licence for the underlying list.

providers.name: The National Archives — Find Case Law

evidence.paraphrase: Ordinary reading/copying/citation is licensed subject to attribution, currency, court restrictions and third-party exclusions. Computational analysis and search-engine indexing are excluded.

Guidance distinguishes individual reading/downloads from systematic automated processing across many judgments. It lists AI products, NLP and vector databases among analysis examples; licence application is free.

providers.eligibility: Ordinary OJL use needs no application; computational use needs an approved separate licence.
providers.no_paste_route: For ordinary use, link to or download the specific needed judgment under OJL conditions. Before automated judgment analysis/RAG, resolve licence scope; no application sent.
providers.uncertainty: Do not equate public API with unrestricted AI reuse or equate every single-case AI reading with bulk analysis. Exact local-agent use needs clarification where guidance examples overlap.

providers.name: Google Street View

evidence.paraphrase: Platform terms restrict scraping, storage outside the services, derived content and model improvement (including training/testing/validation/fine-tuning). Consumer terms separately restrict copying and mass downloading.

Static API requires billing and a key/OAuth token; imagery display needs attribution. Panorama IDs have an indefinite-storage exception, which is not an image-cache permission. EEA billing addresses have separate terms.

providers.eligibility: Google project, enabled billing and authentication for Static API.
providers.no_paste_route: Link to the official Street View viewer for user inspection. A permitted API display integration is a separate review, not a free offline-image source.
providers.uncertainty: One-off AI inference is not synonymous with model training, but derived-content and extraction terms still need assessment. UK/non-EEA Platform terms were read; do not apply them unchanged to EEA customers.

providers.name: Mapillary

evidence.paraphrase: Official help says imagery is CC-BY-SA and the service is free. Credit the creator and image/source link and satisfy share-alike when applicable.
The provider documents API integration, obtaining a token and attribution for downloaded imagery/data. The demo token is not treated here as a grant to embed that credential in our product.

providers.eligibility: Own developer token for intended integration; no account was created.
providers.no_paste_route: Strong candidate for official API retrieval and attributed local imagery, after checking full developer/service terms and actual coverage; use user-owned credentials.
providers.uncertainty: Full terms returned a login page. Image licence does not automatically cover all derived map-data datasets, API access limits or model-provider retention/training. Specific CC version was not established from the accessible help text.

providers.name: KartaView

evidence.paraphrase: Street imagery and 3D spatial data use CC-BY-SA 4.0; code uses MIT. Data may be copied/distributed/adapted with applicable licence compliance and Grab/KartaView contributor credit.
Provider documents photo GET endpoints at api.openstreetcam.org/2.0/photo/. Current authentication and operational quotas were not resolved.

cost.scope: platform described as free; API commercial service commitments not established

providers.no_paste_route: Promising official photo-API/open-imagery route once current read authentication and rate limits are checked; preserve capture date, creator/source and licence.
providers.uncertainty: Terms and detailed API content were available through official indexed results; direct pages were JS/error responses. No data call or coverage check. Do not mix MIT code licence with image licence.

providers.name: Internet Archive — Wayback Machine

evidence.paraphrase: Availability API identifies an accessible archived capture and its timestamp; CDX supports capture-metadata queries.
Internet Archive does not guarantee the copyright status of hosted material. Presence in an archive is not a reuse licence from the original owner.

providers.eligibility: Availability API documentation shows no account/key requirement.
providers.no_paste_route: Use capture-metadata lookup to link to a specific dated historical page; analyse or retain page content only when that content's rights/access scope are resolved.
providers.uncertainty: Full current Archive terms rendered only a JavaScript notice. Do not use Wayback as automatic permission to retrieve a blocked source or as evidence of current listing availability.

providers.name: Client Money Protect — member lookup

evidence.paraphrase: Terms reserve site copyright and other IP to mydeposits; no positive automation/data-reuse grant was found.

providers.no_paste_route: Direct the user to the scheme's official search; automation/feed permission needs confirmation. Public register access does not establish a bulk-data licence.
providers.uncertainty: This is one protection provider, not every permitted scheme. No company lookup performed. An absent match is not proof of legal noncompliance.

providers.name: Property Redress — agent register

evidence.paraphrase: Main site reserves copyright; linked terms of reference concern the scheme, not a verified public API or website-reuse licence.

providers.no_paste_route: Link to the official agent-finder workflow. No licensed feed or automatic no-paste adapter was established in this bounded search.
providers.uncertainty: The complaints/member portal and logo-download permissions do not license a public membership dataset. Check business identity/branch and other schemes before interpreting absence.

providers.name: The Property Ombudsman — register

evidence.paraphrase: Copying, downloading, storage, adaptation and transmission generally require prior written permission, except statutory exceptions or express permissions.

providers.no_paste_route: Link to official consumer/register search. A reusable local extraction/report adapter needs permission/scope resolution; none obtained.
providers.uncertainty: robots.txt retrieval failed in this pass, so earlier protocol observations were not reverified. Copyright notice is a stated position, not a ruling that every factual mention is unlawful.

providers.name: Propertymark — Find an expert

evidence.paraphrase: Public expert-finder is available, but no website/data automation licence was established. Member-only resources and business templates are separate products.

providers.no_paste_route: Open official expert-finder for the user; a feed/automated lookup remains unresolved.
providers.uncertainty: A privacy policy is not a data-reuse licence. robots.txt retrieval failed. Voluntary accreditation absence is not proof of unlawful trading.

providers.name: Heat Trust — registered sites

evidence.paraphrase: Membership applies to registered networks and relevant contractual supply arrangements, not every site of a listed operator. Heat Trust permits its trademark only for registered participants/sites.

providers.no_paste_route: Link to the specific official registered-sites page/map; confirm the exact network rather than an operator logo. No published licensed feed was established.
providers.uncertainty: No positive automation/reuse terms located in this bounded pass. Government-regulation status does not turn this private scheme register into OGL data.

providers.name: Ofgem — published guidance/data

evidence.paraphrase: Ofgem Crown content is reusable free under OGL, excluding logos and identified third-party content; hyperlinks and video embeds are allowed.

providers.eligibility: Public Crown content; specific registers/datasets may have separate conditions.
providers.no_paste_route: Read/download relevant official guidance and published datasets with attribution. Review separate register endpoints before automating them.
providers.uncertainty: General website copyright permission does not verify every external or signed-in register, API, third-party dataset or service rate limit.
